name: Hate Moss
description: Discover the alternative sounds of Hate Moss as they present their latest work, "A Hot Mess", at this intimate venue.
longDescription:
Hate Moss, the alternative duo, will perform their new material from "A Hot Mess" at Ferro Bar on October 8, 2026. Known for their distinctive soundscapes and experimental approach, the band brings their latest musical explorations to Porto, offering an opportunity to engage with their evolving artistic direction.

Attendees can expect an evening focused on contemporary alternative music within the intimate setting of Ferro Bar. The performance will showcase the band's new work, providing a focused listening experience for fans of the genre. The venue's atmosphere is conducive to close-up musical encounters.

This is a ticketed event. Ferro Bar is located in central Porto, a short walk from São Bento metro station and train station, and accessible via several bus lines.
